description: Authoritative time and forecast semantics specification.

climatology_period.description: Climatological baseline period description (e.g. '1991-2020 August decadal mean').
climatology_period.title: Climatology Period

lead_time_seconds.description: Forecast lead time offset tau in seconds (>= 0).
lead_time_seconds.title: Lead Time Seconds

observation_time_utc.description: Exact in-situ measurement or satellite pass timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).
observation_time_utc.title: Observation Time Utc

reference_time_utc.description: Forecast analysis / model cycle initialization time (ISO 8601 UTC e.g. '2026-08-30T00:00:00Z').
reference_time_utc.title: Reference Time Utc

source_time_string.description: Original provider time encoding string (e.g. 'hours since 1950-01-01 00:00:00').
source_time_string.title: Source Time String

time_bounds_utc.description: [start_time_utc, end_time_utc] interval bounds for time-averaged data (e.g. daily mean).
time_bounds_utc.title: Time Bounds Utc

timestep_index.description: Zero-based timestep index in the temporal sequence.
timestep_index.title: Timestep Index

valid_time_utc.description: Authoritative physical valid time of the field state (ISO 8601 UTC).
valid_time_utc.title: Valid Time Utc

title: TimeSemanticsContract
